prompt: What does the guide say about the pane on the right?
promptZh: 導覽員怎麼介紹右邊那片玻璃？

options.text: It replaced broken glass during a stall expansion and was used in the market.
options.zh: 攤位擴建時裝來替換破掉的玻璃，且曾在市場使用。
options.whyZh: 右邊的玻璃在攤位擴建時替換了破玻璃；講者也說兩片玻璃都曾在市場使用。

options.text: It replaced broken glass during a stall expansion but was made only for the display.
options.zh: 攤位擴建時裝來替換破掉的玻璃，但它是專為展示而製作的。
options.whyZh: 攤位擴建時替換這點正確，但講者說兩片玻璃都曾在市場使用，並非只用於展示。

options.text: It was the panel from one of the oldest stalls and was used in the market.
options.zh: 那是最早一批攤位中的玻璃，且曾在市場使用。
options.whyZh: 兩片都曾在市場使用，但講者說來自最早一批攤位的是左邊那片，不是他對右邊那片的描述。

options.text: It was the panel from one of the oldest stalls but was made only for the display.
options.zh: 那是最早一批攤位中的玻璃，但它是專為展示而製作的。
options.whyZh: 來自最早一批攤位是左邊那片的描述，而且兩片玻璃都曾在市場使用。

explanationZh: 右邊的玻璃在攤位擴建時替換了破玻璃；講者也說兩片玻璃都曾在市場使用。
evidence: The right one replaced a broken panel when the stall was enlarged. / Both were used in the market.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The right one replaced a broken panel when the stall was enlarged.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Both were used in the market.

vocabulary.note: one of 後接複數名詞。

vocabulary.zh: 替換了一塊破掉的玻璃板
vocabulary.note: replace 在此指以新的玻璃板換下破損的板。
